item.title: My Favorite Development Tools in 2024
item.description:
Here are some development tools I can’t live without:

  1. VS Code - The best code editor
  2. Docker - Container management made easy
  3. Git - Version control system
  4. Postman - API testing tool

What are your favorite development tools?
